author: MarkDNZ

title: Good but missing some very good features
body:
Great, easy to use, like all the features as they are so far. Google calendar integration is spot on. 

A few thoughts on useful additions:
- having a larger widget available 
- ability to have multiple widgets running at the same time showing different lists
- The ability to upload a photo, file or add a link to a onedrive file (for example) would be IMMENSELY useful. This would be a great feature, especially as a student, if i set a task to do smth study related, being able to link directly to the document or file or folder i need to work on would be so handy. Otherwise I leave the app and to go to the task and try find the folder and I easily get sidetracked along the way, 
- ability to repeat the task multiple times WITHIN the *same day*, not just daily. Eg repeating the task at 2 hr intervals. This would be useful for study, but I can imagine it would also be useful for people managing medication, for example. 
- One other cool integration would be with apple screen time. for example when a time based task pops up, activating a productivity or study mode, for example, would be amazing
